notes: Copilot long-idle: the row must survive an idle window longer than readyTTL purely because its PID is alive, then resume normally on the next prompt. Recorded with IRRLICHT_READY_SESSION_TTL=15s so the 15 s duration_at_least_ms cleanly exceeds the TTL (production is 30 min). The daemon-side mechanism is adapter-agnostic (pid_manager.go:1026 returns before the reap when the bound PID answers Kill(pid,0)), so the copilot-specific precondition is the PID bind — asserted explicitly as pid_bind rather than left implicit, because a 20 s window is too short for reapUnboundReadyGhost (>30 s stale UpdatedAt AND >2 min stale transcript) to turn a missing bind into a visible disappearance. State stability during the window is structural: every copilot event type that can fire while the user is away (session.usage_checkpoint, session.shutdown, model_change, auto_mode_resolved, system.message, assistant.turn_start, unknown future types) is Skip=true in the parser, so only user.message and assistant.turn_end can move state. PRESESSION SHAPE (CONFIRMED live 2026-08-03, no longer provisional): copilot creates session-state/<id>/ at launch with only workspace.yaml and writes events.jsonl on the first prompt, so processlifecycle.Scanner mints a proc-<PID> row (born ready) before the fswatcher sees any transcript, and the real session arrives under a DIFFERENT id ~8s later, superseding it. BIRTH RE-ANCHORED: that real session is born DIRECTLY into working, because the file already carries the open first turn — so session_birth and first_turn_start are ONE phase, and every later phase, the idle window included, anchors to the REAL session. TTL NON-VACUITY: IRRLICHT_READY_SESSION_TTL=15s was exported for the run, record_daemon_env forwards it into the daemon env (verified by invoking that function directly) and config.go:75 reads it; the observed idle window was 22.3s, 1.49x the TTL, with no transcript_removed for the real session. OBSERVATIONS: tokens and cost are live from assistant.message.outputTokens through the shared capacity price map (session.usage_checkpoint carries no token counts). model is NOT pinned: --model accepts only "auto" and session.auto_mode_resolved picks between gpt-5-mini and claude-haiku-4.5 per turn — with two turns in this recipe the two could legitimately differ.
